The successful candidate will be a technical leader who can independently drive complex CAN controller bring-up and driver development, resolve difficult silicon/firmware issues, influence hardware and software architecture, and mentor engineers across the firmware organization. What you’ll achieve: CAN and CAN FD Driver Define the firmware architecture and technical roadmap for low-level CAN and CAN FD controller drivers on Arm-based SoCs. Develop scalable driver designs for Classical CAN and CAN FD; bit-rate switching (BRS); dedicated TX buffers, TX FIFOs, TX queues, mailboxes, and RX FIFOs; hardware acceptance filters; interrupt-driven and polling operation; timestamping where supported; error handling, diagnostics, and recovery. Define robust software state machines for controller initialization, start/stop, sleep/wakeup, error-active, error-passive, bus-off, recovery, reset, and degraded operation. Develop and maintain production-quality embedded C code for CAN controller initialization, transmit, receive, interrupt handling, error handling, and recovery. Arm SoC and Hardware/Software Integration Drive CAN controller bring-up on Arm-based SoCs and evaluate hardware behavior against specifications and expected protocol behavior. Influence early SoC and IP architecture decisions related to CAN controller capabilities, memory sizing, interrupt architecture, diagnostics, and performance. Integration Define and support CAN driver integration within a Platform stack, including CanDrv; CanIf; PduR; COM; CanSM; CanTrcv; Dem; E2E; BswM, EcuM, and WdgM, as applicable. Ensure clear separation of responsibilities between low-level driver, CAN interface layer, communication stack, diagnostics, and application software. Contribute to customer-facing integration guides, application notes, reference drivers, and debug documentation. Reliability, and Diagnostics Design CAN firmware behavior aligned with industry standard development practices. Define software mechanisms to detect and report bus-off; error passive and error warning conditions; protocol errors; ACK errors; RX FIFO overflow; RX buffer/message loss; TX timeout; message RAM ECC/parity errors; controller clock/reset faults; transceiver fault/status conditions; configuration corruption; interrupt failures or abnormal interrupt load. Develop diagnostic strategies, persistent error capture, health monitoring, and recovery policies suitable for production environment. Establish high standards for embedded software quality, maintainability, robustness, and testability. Drive adoption of secure coding practices, including MISRA C, CERT C, static analysis, defensive programming, and code review discipline. Define unit, integration, system, and hardware-in-the-loop validation strategies for CAN drivers. Analyze field, customer, and lab failures; develop reproducible test cases and permanent corrective actions. Technical Leadership and Mentoring Serve as the technical authority for CAN firmware and low-level CAN driver architecture. Lead architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and technical debugging sessions. Mentor firmware engineers in embedded C, CAN/CAN FD protocol behavior, Arm architecture, driver design, debugging, and quality practices. Create reusable design patterns, driver templates, checklists, debug guides, and validation frameworks. Lead technical discussions with hardware design, verification, validation, systems, cybersecurity, product, field applications, and customer teams. Drive technical risk identification, mitigation planning, and escalation for critical CAN firmware deliverables. Experience working in a semiconductor company or embedded platform in a product environment is strongly preferred. Strong hands-on expertise in Classical CAN; CAN FD; bit-rate switching; arbitration; error frames and error counters; error-active, error-passive, and bus-off states; acceptance filtering; RX FIFO and TX mailbox/FIFO/queue management; controller/transceiver interaction; nominal and data-phase bit timing. Expert-level embedded C programming skills with Arm Cortex-M, Cortex-R, Cortex-A, or equivalent embedded processor architectures. Strong understanding of register programming; interrupt handling; interrupt latency and priority; ISR/task concurrency; synchronization, atomics, critical sections, and race conditions; boot and initialization ordering; linker sections, alignment, and memory layout. Ability to debug issues using JTAG/SWD, GDB, vendor debuggers, trace tools, register viewers, crash dumps, and low-level instrumentation. title: Research Fellow in Genetic Epidemiology and Data Science
full_description: The Faculty of Medicine at the University of Southampton invites applications for a three-year, full-time, fixed-term Research Fellow to join Professor Hanieh Yaghootkar’s interdisciplinary precision-diabetes research programme. Based at University Hospital Southampton, you will investigate the biological mechanisms underlying type 2 diabetes by integrating measures of organ health with large-scale genetic and clinical data. Working alongside genetic epidemiologists, clinicians and data scientists, you will apply advanced statistical and machine learning approaches to identify distinct diabetes subtypes, investigate their genetic determinants and improve prediction of disease risk and progression. The role As a Research Fellow, You Will Develop and apply machine learning approaches to identify distinct subtypes of type 2 diabetes using measures of liver, pancreas, adipose tissue and skeletal muscle health. Characterise the clinical, metabolic and genetic profiles of diabetes subtypes and evaluate their reproducibility across populations. Conduct genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of organ-health traits and diabetes subtypes, and apply Mendelian randomisation to investigate potential causal relationships. Develop and evaluate statistical and machine learning models to predict incident type 2 diabetes and disease progression using genetic and clinical data. Analyse large-scale population datasets, including UK Biobank, using robust statistical methods and reproducible computational workflows. Contribute to high-quality scientific publications, conference presentations and the dissemination of research findings. Collaborate with multidisciplinary researchers across genetic epidemiology, genomics, clinical medicine, imaging, statistics and data science. You will have opportunities to develop your research expertise, contribute to innovative analytical approaches and build your publication record within an internationally collaborative research environment. About You You will have: A PhD in in genetic epidemiology, statistical genetics, biostatistics, data science, computational biology or a closely related discipline. Experience analysing large-scale genetic, epidemiological or biomedical datasets, ideally including UK Biobank. Strong statistical and computational skills, including proficiency in R and/or Python and experience working in Linux-based computing environments. Practical experience conducting GWAS and Mendelian randomisation analyses, including appropriate quality control, sensitivity analyses and interpretation. Experience applying machine learning, clustering, predictive modelling or other advanced statistical methods to complex biomedical data. An understanding of genetic epidemiology and the application of statistical methods to investigate complex disease mechanisms. Evidence of high-quality research outputs, including peer-reviewed publications. Excellent analytical, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary research teams. Experience with metabolic disease research would be advantageous. What We Can Offer At Southampton, you will join a supportive, internationally connected research environment at the forefront of genetic epidemiology, data science and precision medicine. We offer: Access to large-scale biomedical datasets, high-performance computing infrastructure and secure analytical environments. Opportunities to work at the interface of human genetics, medical imaging, machine learning and metabolic disease research. Collaboration with leading researchers across clinical medicine, genomics, epidemiology and computational science. Opportunities for high-impact publications, scientific conferences, professional development and career progression. A supportive and inclusive working environment committed to equality, diversity and flexible working, including Athena SWAN principles. A competitive University benefits package, including pension provision and generous annual leave. For informal enquiries, contact Professor Hanieh Yaghootkar (h.yaghootkar@soton.ac.uk). Working At The University Of Southampton Check out the staff benefits and why you should join us at The University of Southampton. A standard DBS check is required for this role. full_description: We are seeking an experienced and results-driven PySpark / Big Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain large-scale batch and real-time data pipelines. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming complex raw data into actionable analytical data models, optimizing distributed computing workloads, and ensuring data integrity, scalability, and security across enterprise data platforms. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Apache Spark architecture, advanced Python programming, distributed systems optimization, modern cloud platforms, and data warehousing/lakehouse paradigms. Key Responsibilities Data Pipeline Design & Development Architect, build, and maintain robust, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using PySpark and Python to ingest data from diverse batch and streaming sources (Kafka, relational databases, REST APIs, Object Storage). Design and implement Lakehouse architectures using formats such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or Apache Hudi. Build reusable frameworks and data ingestion libraries to standardize enterprise data processing. Spark Performance Tuning & Optimization Diagnose and tune Spark application performance, managing memory allocation, partitions, execution plans, broadcast joins, data skews, and garbage collection. Optimize query execution plans using Catalyst Optimizer and Tungsten execution engine. Monitor and troubleshoot production Spark jobs across cluster management environments (YARN, Kubernetes, or Databricks). Data Modeling & Architecture Collaborate with Data Architects to design dimensional (Star/Snowflake), normalized, and Data Vault schemas optimized for analytical workloads. Ensure efficient data storage, partitioning strategies, and file format selection (Parquet, ORC, Avro). Orchestration, CI/CD & DevOps Schedule and orchestrate complex workflow DAGs using workflow orchestrators such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster. Implement CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) for automated testing, packaging, and deployment of data pipelines. Write unit tests, integration tests, and data validation routines (e.g., Great Expectations, PyTest). Governance, Security & Quality Implement enterprise data governance, lineage tracking, metadata management, and data quality frameworks. Ensure strict compliance with data security, masking, tokenization, RBAC, and regulatory privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA). Required Technical Qualifications & Skills Core Technologies - Apache Spark, PySpark (Spark SQL, DataFrames, Datasets, Structured Streaming), Python 3.x Database & Querying - Advanced SQL, Query optimization, Indexing, Window functions Data Lake & Lakehouse - Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Parquet, Avro, ORC Workflow & Orchestration - Apache Airflow, Luigi, Prefect, or Databricks Workflows Cloud Platforms - AWS (EMR, Glue, S3, Redshift), Azure (Synapse, ADLS, HDInsight), or GCP (Dataproc, BigQuery, GCS) Streaming Technologies - Apache Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Event Hubs, or Kinesis Key Competencies & Experience Distributed Computing Fundamentals: In-depth knowledge of Spark internals (RDD, Catalyst Optimizer, DAG execution, Shuffling, Narrow vs. Wide dependencies). Production Experience: Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade PySpark applications at enterprise scale. Problem Solving: Proven track record in debugging memory bottlenecks, Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors, and resolving data skew issues. Data Engineering Best Practices: Experience implementing modular code architectures, logging, monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch), and alerting. Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have) Hands-on experience with Databricks platform (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Photon engine, MLflow). Familiarity with Scala/Java in addition to Python. Knowledge of DataOps and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). Experience with modern analytical data warehouses (Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift). Relevant certifications: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate / Professional AWS Certified Data Engineer / Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)CCA Spark and Hadoop Developer (or equivalent) Educational Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience). full_description: Role Overview & Objective The Senior IT Business Analyst – Fraud Prevention translates complex, high-level business and risk requirements into detailed, actionable technology deliverables. Serving as the primary bridge between Fraud Operations, Compliance, Risk Management, and Technology engineering teams, you will leverage modern analysis methodologies and enterprise AI capabilities to define, design, and implement advanced fraud detection and mitigation solutions. Your contributions will directly strengthen organizational resilience against emerging fraud threats while ensuring a frictionless customer journey. Key Responsibilities Requirements Engineering & Business Analysis Leverage enterprise collaboration intelligence and AI-assisted elicitation tools to structure stakeholder workshops, extract business rules from discussions, and resolve requirement ambiguities and edge-case exceptions with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). Elicit, analyze, and document comprehensive functional and non-functional requirements, producing industry-standard Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and technical specifications. Utilize advanced analytical tools for requirement pattern discovery and dependency mapping across distributed systems. Design and maintain robust process artifacts—including use case models, activity diagrams, sequence diagrams, system context diagrams, and Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN 2.0) workflows—covering standard operating paths, fraud-positive scenarios, false-positive handling, timeouts, vendor outages, and dual-control approvals. Define detailed technical and integration requirements for in-house detection engines, third-party vendor platforms, and core payment rails (e.g., Card Authorization, ACH, Wire, Real-Time Payments [RTP]). Decompose business initiatives into structured Jira Epics and INVEST-compliant User Stories featuring testable Gherkin syntax (Given-When-Then) acceptance criteria across diverse personas Establish and maintain end-to-end Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) linking regulatory/policy mandates to BRDs, FRDs, user stories, test cases, and compliance audit evidence. Facilitate backlog grooming and sprint planning in Jira, ensuring user stories meet the Definition of Ready (DoR) and align with engineering sprint capacity. AI-Powered Fraud Solution Design Translate evolving fraud typologies—such as Account Takeover (ATO), Authorized Push Payment (APP) fraud, Synthetic Identity Theft, and mule account networks—into functional and technical specifications for machine learning models and real-time rule engines. Perform comprehensive impact assessments and root-cause analyses on fraud policy and rule updates, balancing fraud capture rate optimization against customer friction and False Positive Rates (FPR). System Integration & Testing Serve as the core technical liaison across core banking engines, fraud decisioning platforms, case management workflows, and identity verification/biometric APIs. Define data mapping specifications, schema definitions (JSON/XML), and API payloads for real-time transaction screening, event streaming (e.g., Kafka), and batch monitoring. Formulate and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) strategies, detailed test scripts, and defect triage workflows to validate fraud detection efficacy and system reliability prior to production releases. Required Qualifications & Experience Education & Experience Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), Finance, Business Analytics, or a related discipline. Enterprise Fraud & Risk Platforms: Practical experience with market-leading fraud detection and decisioning engines. Job Title: Staff Engineer – Knowledge Management Location: Bangalore Business & Team: The Chief AI Office (CAIO) drives the bank’s AI strategy, platforms, governance, and capabilities to accelerate the safe and scalable adoption of AI across the enterprise. The Knowledge Management domain within CAIO creates the cognitive foundation of the bank by transforming business knowledge into trusted, governed, and reusable knowledge products. As a Staff Engineer – Knowledge Management, you will work closely with Knowledge Governance & Framework Leads, Knowledge Platform & Engineering Teams, Business SMEs, knowledge owners, product teams, and DHP platform and DevSecOps teams. Impact & Contribution: You will directly support CAIO's objective of creating the bank's enterprise knowledge capability and trusted knowledge products that accelerate AI-powered transformation across the Group. You will enable colleagues, copilots, and AI agents to access trusted, governed, and reusable enterprise knowledge, improving decision-making consistency and productivity. You will help reduce duplication of knowledge, manual research effort, and rework by transforming fragmented information into reusable knowledge products with clear ownership, lineage, and controls. You will build enterprise AI/ML and knowledge platform capabilities that make business policies, procedures, controls, and operational knowledge AI-ready and safely consumable at scale. You will strengthen governance, explainability, and risk management through metadata, provenance, permissions, evaluation, and auditability built into the knowledge lifecycle. Roles & Responsibilities: Enterprise Knowledge Products: Design and build enterprise-scale knowledge products that transform unstructured information into trusted, reusable, and AI-ready assets. AI/ML Platform Development: Design and develop scalable, production-grade AI/ML platforms and capabilities supporting enterprise AI, knowledge management, retrieval, and GenAI use cases. Ontology, Taxonomy & Knowledge Graphs: Develop and maintain enterprise ontology, semantic models, metadata, taxonomy, and knowledge graphs that provide shared context across business domains. Knowledge Platform Engineering: Engineer knowledge ingestion, enrichment, retrieval, APIs, integrations, and lifecycle management capabilities for governed knowledge products. Knowledge Governance: Build and enforce knowledge governance controls covering ownership, lineage, provenance, classification, permissions, auditability, and lifecycle policies. Policy-as-Code & Decisioning: Implement policy-as-code and deterministic decisioning capabilities to deliver consistent, explainable, and compliant AI outcomes. AI Guardrails & Retrieval Controls: Develop AI guardrails, retrieval controls, and policy-aware access mechanisms to ensure only authorised and trusted knowledge is exposed to LLMs and agents. AI & Agent Integration: Integrate the knowledge platform with LLM gateways, agent frameworks, evaluation frameworks, and AI platform services to accelerate safe adoption of agentic AI solutions. Quality, Evaluation & Observability: Establish quality, observability, evaluation, and feedback loops to continuously improve knowledge accuracy, trustworthiness, retrieval effectiveness, and business outcomes. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work across engineering, CAIO, CDO, product teams, business SMEs, and knowledge owners to translate complex business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products. Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience developing scalable, reliable, secure, and reusable platform components. AI/ML Platform Development: Strong hands-on experience designing and developing enterprise AI/ML platforms and production-grade AI capabilities. Experience with scalable platform architecture, APIs, integration patterns, data/AI pipelines, observability, security, and cloud-native engineering. Knowledge Management & Ontology Development: Strong understanding and hands-on experience in Knowledge Management and ontology development , including knowledge graphs, semantic modelling, taxonomy, and metadata management for enterprise-scale knowledge ecosystems. Strong experience in unstructured data processing, document understanding, information extraction, entity resolution, and knowledge enrichment pipelines. RAG, GraphRAG & Retrieval: Hands-on experience in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector databases, search technologies, and retrieval optimisation for AI-powered knowledge systems. Knowledge of ingestion pipelines, enrichment, retrieval, lifecycle management, APIs, integration patterns, and enterprise platform engineering. Knowledge Governance & Responsible AI: Strong understanding of knowledge governance, data governance, lineage, provenance, access control, compliance, permissions, classification, and auditability frameworks. Experience implementing AI guardrails, retrieval controls, policy-aware access, evaluation mechanisms, and governance controls for safe consumption of enterprise knowledge. GenAI & Agentic AI Integration: Experience integrating LLM gateways, agent frameworks, AI platforms, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and model orchestration services. Familiarity with agentic AI architectures, multi-agent orchestration, MCP patterns, and tool-based reasoning systems is desirable. Policy-as-Code & Decisioning: Ability to implement policy-as-code, executable knowledge, rules engines, and deterministic decisioning patterns to support explainable and compliant AI outcomes. Experience with BPMN, DMN, policy engines, and executable knowledge is desirable. Programming Languages & Tools: Strong proficiency in Python with 10+ years of hands-on development experience as a key requirement, together with TypeScript/Node.js and SQL exposure for platform engineering, APIs, data pipelines, and AI integrations. Experience with cloud-based AI, knowledge management, semantic technologies, or knowledge graph platforms is desirable. Understanding of process intelligence, process mining, business capability modelling, and decision modelling to capture and operationalise organisational knowledge is desirable. Clear communication and documentation skills with the ability to explain complex AI/ML platform, knowledge architecture, governance, and AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong ownership mindset with a focus on automation, continuous improvement, scalability, and reusable engineering practices. This is the next career level above Senior Software Engineer . The step-up is defined by deeper technical ownership, higher quality output, and greater independence — not a change in tools or scope. A Principal Engineer on this team owns their service implementations end to end, requires no guidance on complex backend problems, sets the code quality bar that others follow, and contributes meaningfully to low-level design decisions. The Platform Team builds infrastructure that other teams depend on — platform services must be reliable, observable, well-documented, and designed to be consumed by agent squads who did not build them. LLM tooling concepts: what the platform must support for agents to operate on it. Close collaboration with the Platform Software Architect on implementation decisions, and the opportunity to mentor Senior Engineers — the Principal level is where individual technical excellence directly shapes the quality standards of the broader team. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do. Develop and maintain Python-based backend services (such as FastAPI) that expose agent capabilities via REST and server-sent event (SSE) streaming endpoints. Implement secure agent pipelines that correctly propagate user identity and entitlements, ensuring agent behaviour is scoped to individual client subscriptions. Apply a strong understanding of AI-specific security concerns - including prompt injection, adversarial inputs, agent behaviour risks, and reputational exposure - to design agents that are robust and trustworthy in a production enterprise environment. Integrate AI agents with Azure cloud services and internal platform APIs, following established architectural patterns set by the AI Research and Product Team. Collaborate closely with the HCA platform team in an agile delivery environment - helping steer and contributing to sprint planning, reviews, and ceremonies. Work alongside the AI Research and Product Team during onboarding and early delivery, absorbing patterns and progressively taking on more independent ownership of agent design decisions. Proactively communicate blockers, unknowns, and design questions - particularly when working at the frontier of rapidly evolving AI tooling. Stay current with the fast-moving AI engineering landscape; evaluate new frameworks, models, and patterns and bring relevant developments back to the team. Proven ability to give technical direction to strong, experienced engineers and to run delivery autonomously, making sound decisions independently and knowing when to align with the wider team. Solid understanding of agentic AI concepts and patterns: Tool use, state management, and multi-step reasoning Checkpointing, human-in-the-loop flows, and agent interrupts Multi-agent architectures and orchestration patterns Hands-on experience with agentic or LLM frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Claude Agent SDK, or similar); formal professional experience is a plus but demonstrable hands-on capability - including personal projects and sandbox work - is equally valued. Awareness of AI-specific security risks including prompt injection, adversarial inputs, and agent behaviour vulnerabilities - and how to design against them. Experience with observability practices in backend systems: structured logging, distributed tracing, and monitoring; familiarity with AI-specific evaluation and tracing concepts (e.g. MLflow, LangSmith, or similar) is a strong advantage. Experience with containerisation (Docker) for packaging and deploying backend services. Comfortable using AI coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Cursor) as part of a day-to-day development workflow. Comfortable leading delivery in an agile environment and setting the pace for iterative, dependable execution. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills; proactive in surfacing blockers, unknowns, and design questions across teams and time zones. Genuine curiosity and drive for self-directed learning in a fast-moving technical space. Preferred / Good-to-Have Hands-on experience with LangGraph and/or LangChain in a production or near-production context. Experience with AWS cloud services (ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, Secrets Manager, S3). Familiarity with PostgreSQL and async database access patterns (psycopg3, SQLAlchemy, or similar). Experience with agent evaluation frameworks and experiment tracking (MLflow, Databricks Agents, or equivalent). Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for AI systems - automated testing, evaluation gates, and deployment of model-backed services. Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL - useful when working alongside the existing HCA platform team. Prior experience building AI features within enterprise SaaS platforms or data-heavy products. Relevant certifications (e.g. Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty).
